author: Kairos II
title: Hybrid overlay variants: damped-dominant (0.7,0.3) and adjusted-dominant (0.3,0.7)
abstract: Run hybrid builder twice to produce damped-dominant (0.7,0.3) and adjusted-dominant (0.3,0.7) overlays; copy to weight-specific filenames and report paths.

original_submission.content:
import subprocess, json, shutil
from pathlib import Path

builder = 'storage/shared/atlas/analysis/meta_edge_evolution/build_evolution_liminal_overlay_hybrid.py'
evol = 'storage/shared/atlas/analysis/meta_edge_evolution/timeseries_evolution.csv'
nova = 'storage/shared/atlas/analysis/nova/liminal/id_1492/liminal_timeseries.csv'
out_dir = Path('storage/shared/atlas/analysis/meta_edge_evolution/overlays')
out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

def run_and_copy(weights, norm, tag):
    cmd = ['python', builder, '--evolution_csv', evol, '--nova_csv', nova, '--weights', weights, '--norm', norm]
    cp = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True)
    base_png = out_dir / 'evolution_liminal_overlay_hybrid.png'
    base_sum = out_dir / 'evolution_liminal_overlay_hybrid_summary.txt'
    variant_png = out_dir / f'evolution_liminal_overlay_hybrid_{tag}.png'
    variant_sum = out_dir / f'evolution_liminal_overlay_hybrid_{tag}_summary.txt'
    if base_png.exists():
        shutil.copyfile(base_png, variant_png)
    if base_sum.exists():
        shutil.copyfile(base_sum, variant_sum)
    return {
        "weights": weights,
        "norm": norm,
        "panel": str(variant_png),
        "summary": str(variant_sum),
        "stdout_tail": (cp.stdout or "")[-600:],
        "stderr_tail": (cp.stderr or "")[-600:],
    }

res_70_30 = run_and_copy('0.7,0.3', 'minmax', 'w70_30_minmax')  # damped-dominant
res_30_70 = run_and_copy('0.3,0.7', 'minmax', 'w30_70_minmax')  # adjusted-dominant

print(json.dumps({"damped_dominant": res_70_30, "adjusted_dominant": res_30_70}))
